statement: The function returns a result r and r equals the number of distinct byte values occurring in s, i.e., r = |{ c : c is a byte and there exists i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = c }|.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122 (all characters are lowercase ASCII letters).

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= len(s).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= 26.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: If every character in s is the same (i.e., for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = s[0]), then the function returns a result r and r = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: If all characters in s are pairwise distinct (i.e., for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(s), s[i] != s[j]), then the function returns a result r and r = len(s).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: If every lowercase ASCII letter c with 97 <= c <= 122 occurs in s (i.e., for every such c there exists i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = c), then the function returns a result r and r = 26.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: For every byte array t satisfying the preconditions, if the set of characters occurring in t equals the set of characters occurring in s (i.e., for every byte c, there exists i with 0 <= i < len(t) and t[i] = c if and only if there exists j with 0 <= j < len(s) and s[j] = c), then the function returns a result r_s on s and a result r_t on t, and r_s = r_t.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: For every nonempty byte array t satisfying the preconditions that is a subsequence of s (i.e., there exist indices 0 <= i_1 < i_2 < ... < i_{len(t)} < len(s) such that t[k] = s[i_{k+1}] for all 0 <= k < len(t)), the function returns a result r_s on s and a result r_t on t, and r_t <= r_s.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exist indices i_1, i_2, ..., i_r with 0 <= i_1 < i_2 < ... < i_r < len(s) such that the characters s[i_1], s[i_2], ..., s[i_r] are pairwise distinct and the set {s[i_1], s[i_2], ..., s[i_r]} equals the set of all characters occurring in s (i.e., for every byte c, c occurs in s if and only if c = s[i_k] for some k in {1, ..., r}).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122 (all characters are lowercase ASCII letters).

statement: For every pair of nonempty byte arrays s1 and s2 satisfying the preconditions such that s = s1 ++ s2 (i.e., len(s) = len(s1) + len(s2), s[i] = s1[i] for 0 <= i < len(s1), and s[len(s1)+j] = s2[j] for 0 <= j < len(s2)), the function returns a result r on s, a result r1 on s1, and a result r2 on s2, and r <= r1 + r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.
